en.summary: Prime Minister Modi inaugurated Chennai Metro Rail's Phase 2 stretch after six years of construction, with the first train running from Porur Bypass. Modi and the Chief Minister were among the initial passengers on the new service.

en.title: Anti-CEC protest LIVE updates: Supreme Court stops illegal detention, orders restoration of Internet and metro services; CJP leaders call situation 'emergency-like'
en.summary: The Supreme Court issued directions during a special hearing to permit free movement in Delhi and prevent unlawful detentions. The court also issued a notice regarding potential contempt proceedings over alleged violations of earlier transit shutdown orders.

en.summary: Prime Minister Modi launched the Poonamallee-Vadapalani stretch of Chennai Metro Rail Project, featuring a 3.7-km double-decker design and costing approximately 4,900 crore rupees. Daily services commenced with operations scheduled between 7 a.m. and 9 p.m.
